About Us
Thanthai Roever Institute of Agriculture and Rural Development (TRIARD), one of the Roever Group of Educational Institution, which is run by run by the St. John Sangam Trust, was started to offer courses in Diploma in Agriculture during the year 1994, later Diploma in Horticulture on 2001 and B.Sc.(Agri) in 2008.
